rules.title: Massachusetts ban on source-of-income discrimination (public assistance and housing subsidies)
rules.requirement: A Massachusetts landlord may not refuse to rent to you or treat you differently because you receive public assistance or a housing subsidy such as a rental voucher. They also cannot do it because of the subsidy program's requirements.
rules.key_value: Source of income (public assistance, housing subsidies, rental assistance) is a protected class in rentals
rules.coverage_conditions: Any person furnishing rental accommodations in Massachusetts. The statute does not limit this to certain buildings.
rules.reason: There was only one candidate, taken from the official statute text, so it stands as its own record.
